Extract the model object from a fitted mable cell

Source: R/methods.R
jd3_model.Rd

Returns the jd3_model object stored in a fitted model. It is mostly useful for programming; jd3_indicator() and jd3_dictionary() call it internally.

Usage

jd3_model(x)

Arguments

x

A mdl_ts (e.g. mb$x13[[1]]) or a jd3_model.

Value

A jd3_model object: a list holding the data (a tsibble), the series (ts), the final specification (spec), the reference specification (ref_spec), the modelling context, the engine, the name of the response and a cache for the Java result.

Examples

mb <- model(tsibble::as_tsibble(AirPassengers), x13 = X13(value))
m <- jd3_model(mb$x13[[1]])
class(m)
#> [1] "X13"          "jd3_model"    "jd3_sa_model"
